M-DBG-CORE.Purpose: WidgetInspector tool lifecycle, context selection, snapshot refresh and the inspector window.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Tool initialization, shutdown, global F12 toggle, selected engine/widget and InspectorSettings.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Inspection, property observation, presentation and drawing belong to sibling M-DBG modules.

Requirements.REQ-001: Initialize enables observation; Shutdown closes the window, releases its FVUI context, removes patches and disposes subscriptions.
Requirements.REQ-002: F12 opens or closes the inspector even when no FlexVerse screen is rendering.
Requirements.REQ-003: Context discovery uses EngineRegistry.List; empty and isolated engines are excluded. Removed contexts and widgets clear stale selection.
Requirements.REQ-004: The inspector receives immutable display snapshots as Props. Only its own UI reconciles; target instances are never reconciled or dirtied by inspection.
Requirements.REQ-005: Closing the window releases its engine. Reopening creates a new UI instance and current snapshot.

Inputs.IN-001: ToolManager lifecycle, engine ProcessUI completion, window contents and hotkey events.

Outputs.OUT-001: InspectorApp definitions and optional overlays for live target engines.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Registers an engine observation postfix and a game hotkey prefix, and opens/closes a Verse window.
